record.question:
Fill in the blanks with suitable words:
(a) Every Officer incurring or authorising expenditure from public money should be guided by high standards of __________.
(b) Under Article 284 of the Constitution all moneys received by or deposited with any officer employed in connection with the affairs of the Union in his capacity as such, other than revenues or public moneys raised or received by Government, shall be paid into the __________.
(c) The financial powers of the Government, which have not been delegated to a subordinate authority, shall vest in the __________.
(d) No authority should exercise its powers of sanctioning expenditure to pass an order which will be directly or indirectly to its __________.
(e) All losses above the value of __________ due to suspected fire, theft, fraud, etc., shall be invariably reported to the Police for investigation as early as possible.
(f) No authority may incur any expenditure or enter into any liability involving expenditure or transfer of moneys for investment or deposit from Government account unless the same has been __________ by a competent authority.
(g) All proposals for sanction to expenditure shall indicate whether such expenditure can be met by valid appropriation or __________.
(h) A sanction for any fresh charge shall, unless it is specifically renewed, lapse if no payment in whole or in part has been made during a period of __________ months from the date of issue of such sanction.
(i) Petty losses of value not exceeding Rupees __________ need not be reported.
(j) __________ shall be held personally responsible for any loss sustained by the Government through fraud or negligence on his part.
